edbDesc: The emission of light (luminescence) with limited emission of heat as the result of a chemical reaction.
title: Chemiluminescence
pickWhy: Borderline: Judgment call: Brand's phosphorus was named 'light-bearer' for its glow in the dark, which is chemiluminescence, so the effect goes on that card; the alternative is a new card dated to Albrecht's luminol (1928).
